import copy
import unittest

from solution import reschedule


class RescheduleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_success_returns_fully_detached_deep_copy(self):
        entries = [
            {"id": "a", "time": {"hour": 8, "minute": 30},
             "details": {"labels": ["one"], "nested": {"x": 1}}},
            {"id": "b", "time": {"hour": 22, "minute": 59},
             "details": {"labels": ["two"]}},
        ]
        original = copy.deepcopy(entries)

        result = reschedule(entries, "b", 0, 0)

        self.assertEqual(result[0], entries[0])
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["time"], {"hour": 0, "minute": 0})
        self.assertEqual(entries, original)
        self.assertIsNot(result, entries)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], entries[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[1], entries[1])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["time"], entries[0]["time"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["details"], entries[0]["details"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["details"]["labels"], entries[0]["details"]["labels"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["details"]["nested"], entries[0]["details"]["nested"])
        result[0]["details"]["labels"].append("changed")
        result[0]["details"]["nested"]["x"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(entries, original)

    def test_boundary_times_are_allowed(self):
        entries = [{"id": "x", "time": {"hour": 12, "minute": 30}}]
        self.assertEqual(reschedule(entries, "x", 0, 0)[0]["time"],
                         {"hour": 0, "minute": 0})
        self.assertEqual(reschedule(entries, "x", 23, 59)[0]["time"],
                         {"hour": 23, "minute": 59})

    def test_rejects_invalid_top_level_arguments(self):
        entries = [{"id": "x", "time": {"hour": 1, "minute": 2}}]
        calls = [
            lambda: reschedule(tuple(entries), "x", 1, 2),
            lambda: reschedule(entries, 1, 1, 2),
            lambda: reschedule(entries, "x", True, 2),
            lambda: reschedule(entries, "x", 1, False),
            lambda: reschedule(entries, "x", 1.5, 2),
            lambda: reschedule(entries, "x", 1, "2"),
            lambda: reschedule(entries, "x", -1, 0),
            lambda: reschedule(entries, "x", 24, 0),
            lambda: reschedule(entries, "x", 0, -1),
            lambda: reschedule(entries, "x", 0, 60),
            lambda: reschedule(entries, "unknown", 1, 2),
        ]
        for call in calls:
            with self.subTest(call=call):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    call()

    def test_rejects_malformed_entries_and_duplicates(self):
        invalid_entries = [
            [1],
            [{}],
            [{"id": "x"}],
            [{"id": 1, "time": {"hour": 1, "minute": 2}}],
            [{"id": "x", "time": []}],
            [{"id": "x", "time": {"hour": 1}}],
            [{"id": "x", "time": {"hour": True, "minute": 2}}],
            [{"id": "x", "time": {"hour": 1, "minute": 2.0}}],
            [{"id": "x", "time": {"hour": 24, "minute": 0}}],
            [{"id": "x", "time": {"hour": 0, "minute": 60}}],
            [{"id": "x", "time": {"hour": 1, "minute": 2}},
             {"id": "x", "time": {"hour": 3, "minute": 4}}],
        ]
        for entries in invalid_entries:
            with self.subTest(entries=entries):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    reschedule(entries, "x", 5, 6)

    def test_validation_failure_never_mutates_even_if_match_precedes_error(self):
        entries = [
            {"id": "target", "time": {"hour": 1, "minute": 2}, "extra": {"x": [1]}},
            {"id": "bad", "time": {"hour": 99, "minute": 0}},
        ]
        original = copy.deepcopy(entries)
        with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
            reschedule(entries, "target", 10, 20)
        self.assertEqual(entries, original)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
